types.name: struct box<T>
types.description: A struct that owns a single heap-allocated value.

functions.name: new
functions.description: Allocates a box and moves a value into it.

functions.name: deref
functions.description: Borrows the value stored in a box.
functions.returnDescription: A read-only reference to the value.

functions.name: deref_mut
functions.description: Mutably borrows the value stored in a box.
functions.returnDescription: A mutable reference to the value.

functions.name: unwrap
functions.description: Consumes a box and returns its value.

functions.name: leak
functions.description: Consumes a box and releases ownership of its allocation.
functions.returnDescription: A raw pointer to the formerly owned value.

functions.name: drop_with
functions.description: Destroys a boxed value with a caller-provided destructor.

parameters.name: drop_value
parameters.description: The function used to destroy the value.

functions.name: drop
functions.description: Releases a box and its allocation.
